independent_exact_check.python_source:
from fractions import Fraction as F
import json
m=c=omega=F(1)
I0=F(1,8)
p=F(3,5)
h=F(1,100)
L=F(7,3)
def H(p,I,eps):
    return p*p/(2*m)+omega*I+eps*omega*p*p*(I-I0)/(m*m*c*c)
cases=[]
for eps in (0,1):
    v=(H(p+h,I0,eps)-H(p-h,I0,eps))/(2*h)
    rate=(H(p,I0+h,eps)-H(p,I0-h,eps))/(2*h)
    f=rate/omega
    assert v==p/m
    assert f==1+eps*v*v/(c*c)
    b_emit=[F(k)/f for k in (1,2)]
    a_receive=[t+(L+v*t)/c for t in b_emit]
    a_emit=[F(k) for k in (1,2)]
    b_receive=[(L+c*t)/(c-v) for t in a_emit]
    da=a_receive[1]-a_receive[0]
    db=f*(b_receive[1]-b_receive[0])
    assert da==(1+v/c)/f
    assert db==f/(1-v/c)
    assert da!=db
    assert H(p,I0,eps)==F(61,200)
    lower=1/(2*m)-eps*omega*I0/(m*m*c*c)
    assert lower>0
    cases.append(dict(epsilon=eps,velocity=str(v),clock_rate=str(f),
        prepared_energy=str(H(p,I0,eps)),kinetic_coefficient_lower_bound=str(lower),
        initial_distance=str(L),a_local_arrival_gap=str(da),
        b_local_arrival_gap=str(db),gap_difference=str(abs(db-da)),ratio=str(da/db)))
print(json.dumps(dict(status="PASS",method="Exact rational central derivatives (Hamiltonian is quadratic in p and linear in I) and independent ray-intersection times with nonzero initial separation.",cases=cases),ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
